full.1.1: Disrespectful attitude towards the participant and his interests, insulting (including with a question; including off-server).
full.1.1.1: Not related to the following sub-paragraphs (see 1.5.1 - regarding opinion).
full.1.1.4: Regarding a member of staff (including ignoring) (use the appropriate channel to complain).
full.1.1.5: Regarding the server, a member of the higher administration, and the staff as a whole (use the appropriate channel to complain).
full.1.2.1: Political, religious, non-discriminatory (also symbols, but not colors and names).
full.1.2.3: Extremist (fascist, Nazi, sectarian), discriminating on national, religious, sexual and other grounds.
full.1.2.4: Propaganda of feminism, LGBT and the like.
full.1.2.5: Calling for illegal actions in real life.
full.1.3.1: Bad words (more than 1 in the message; animal names and words implying foul language).
full.1.3.2: Obscene words (more than 1 in 2 messages; words with sexual content).
full.1.4.1: Spam (various messages that repeat in meaning or do not have it - more than 3 times).
full.1.4.3: Caps (uppercase, more than 20 letters, if not the name or abbreviation).
full.1.4.4: Excessive formatting (special characters, fonts (not embedded in discord), more than 5 letters).
full.1.5.1: Disinformation (deception, including unconfirmed information, opinion), fraud, provocations, trolling (bullying).
full.1.5.3: Any form of manipulation: blackmail, incitement (inducement to violate).
full.1.5.5: Mentioning a participant for no reason.
full.1.5.6: Advertising of third-party information without the permission of management.
full.1.5.7: Offtopic (off-topic channel messages / requests (idea, complaint) outside the relevant channel; in thematic channels, including with regard to language).
full.1.5.8: Distribution, use, storage of private, private information without the permission of its copyright holder.
full.1.6.1: Using system flaws (cheats), spreading information about them (including cheating; use the appropriate channel).
full.1.6.2: Circumvention of punishment (in case of release from punishment, one is forgiven).
full.1.6.3: Raiding (creation of bots, DDoS, violations from multiple accounts or multiple players by agreement) / mass mailing in BOS to server participants.
full.1.6.4: Violation of the official contract with the project.
full.2.1.2: Destroying, exploding, setting fire to (own team), destroying resources or configuring something for no reason (cheating).
full.2.1.3: Building processors or using scripts that load the server or interfere with the game.
full.2.1.4: Start/vote for a kick a player without a reason mentioned in the rules.
full.2.2: Prohibited actions on servers with limited resources.
full.2.2.1: Replacement of blocks, schemes with less or equally effective ones (including replacement of schemes with a map scheme without the need and consent of the players).
full.2.2.2: A large waste of resources when they are scarce (not to get the resource itself / inefficient scheme to get this resource).
full.2.2.4: Draining resources (throwing them out of blocks for no reason).
full.2.2.5: Building in the enemy landing zone.
full.3.1: Violations related to authority (punishment depends on the consequences).
full.3.1.2: Exceeding authority / failure to follow instructions from superiors (directly supervising this member of staff).
full.3.2.2: Ignoring after entering the dialogue for more than 30 minutes.
full.3.2.3: Closing for no reason (list of reasons: inability to solve the problem, ignoring for more than 48 hours by the participant).
full.3.3.2: Account transfer / data drain of your account or account of a staff member.

basic.1.1: Disrespectful attitude to the participant and his interests, insult, threat; ignoring a member of staff is prohibited.
basic.1.5: Deception; begging; manipulation; impersonating someone else; mentioning someone for no reason; advertising third-party information; offtopic; distributing information without the permission of the copyright holder; using an additional account without registration.
basic.1.6: The use of bugs, cheats, spreading information about them, circumvention of punishment, raid, mass mailing in the BOS to the server participants.
basic.2.1: On all servers: building useless blocks; deleting or configuring something for no reason, destroying resources (cheating); processors and scripts that load the server or interfere with the game; voting for someone's kick for no reason.
basic.2.2: On servers with limited resources: replacement of blocks and schemes with less effective ones or without the consent of the players; a large waste of resources when there is a shortage; draining units and resources; construction in the enemy landing zone; conducting RPGs.
basic.3.1: Improper use or abuse of authority, failure to fulfill duties or instructions from superiors.
basic.3.2: Ignoring the ticket, closing for no reason.
basic.3.3: Draining private information; transferring an account or draining the data of one's own or someone else's account of a staff member.
